name: Coconut Cream
siboNotes: Coconut cream is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free and contains beneficial medium-chain triglycerides that are easily absorbed.
preparationTips: Chill canned coconut cream overnight to separate thick cream from liquid
Choose brands without added gums or thickeners for better digestive tolerance
Whip chilled coconut cream for dairy-free whipped cream substitute
Use in curries, soups, and desserts as lactose-free alternative
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of healthy saturated fats
